title: Heliotrope Health x Redwood - streaming issue check-in
next_steps: Redwood to deploy streaming keep-alive fix to heliotrope-prod and confirm with request IDs
Customer to send 3-5 examples where the stream ends early after mitigation
Redwood to share workaround guidance for client/proxy idle timeouts
transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-11-13 16:00 UTC
Duration: 31 minutes
Attendees: Hannah Schmitt (Redwood), Ethan Park (Redwood), Sam Rivera (Heliotrope), Priya Desai (Heliotrope)

Summary (auto)
Customer reports streaming responses sometimes end early resulting in incomplete answers. Redwood reviews mitigation and planned fix.

Transcript
[00:00] Hannah Schmitt: Thanks for jumping on. We saw your escalation about streaming. Want to confirm what you're seeing today.
[00:12] Sam Rivera: Yeah so uh, the big thing is the stream just stops. Like its mid sentence, then nothing. Sometimes our logs say SSE disconnect, sometimes it's just, like, EOF.
[00:34] Priya Desai: And user sees a partial answer. It's not like the model is refusing, it's literally cut off.
[00:52] Ethan Park: Yep. We traced a bunch of your request IDs. There are long pauses where we aren't sending bytes. Our gateway has an idle timeout, so it closes the connection.
[01:18] Sam Rivera: That would explain why we never see the DONE marker.
[01:26] Ethan Park: Exactly. Short-term we can increase timeout. Longer-term we are adding keep-alive flush, like a heartbeat, so the stream stays open even if there are gaps.
[02:05] Priya Desai: Do we need to change anything on our side?
[02:10] Hannah Schmitt: Possibly your proxy/read timeouts too, depending on your stack. But we think the main issue is our side.
[02:27] Sam Rivera: We also noticed it happens more when tools are enabled.
[02:33] Ethan Park: That's consistent. Tool selection can be quiet for 20 to 40 seconds.
[03:05] Priya Desai: What's the ETA for the real fix, not just the timeout bump?
[03:13] Ethan Park: We have a patch going out. We'll start in your dedicated cluster first once it passes canary, likely by tomorrow.
[03:31] Hannah Schmitt: We'll keep you updated in the ticket. If you have more examples after the mitigation, send them and we can confirm in traces.
[04:02] Sam Rivera: Okay. We'll gather a few with timestamps.
[04:10] Hannah Schmitt: Great. We'll follow up with workaround guidance and confirm deployment.
